text:
Eli: Late-night debate: Steam sale or console Game Pass value? I just picked up 4 indies for $3 each but my roommate says Game Pass has too many big titles to ignore. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Sana: Game Pass for AAA try-before-you-buy. But for deep PC modding and indie vibes, Steam wins hands down.

Victor: Steam for me. sales + cloud saves + my weird controller setup. Also wishlists are dangerous though. :cry:

Rowan: Game Pass if you want value + variety. I discovered weird gems there I wouldn't have bought. Plus I can play on my Xbox in the living room.

Eli: Mods are a strong argument. What about multiplayer? Steam Remote Play vs Xbox multiplayer ecosystem?

Sana: Remote Play is amazing for couch co-op with pals, but latency can be fiddly. If we're talking local LAN nights, PC gives more flexibility (custom servers, maps).

Victor: also quick PSA: if anyone wants to try Splitgate or Don't Starve Together at the next LAN, I can host a headless server.

Rowan: ooh Splitgate please. Also reminder: Friday LAN is potluck. can someone bring an ethernet switch?

Eli: I have a 5-port switch I can bring, and an extra power strip.

build-bot: Reminder: office potluck policy requires labeling allergens. Please add tags to dishes.

Sana: noted. i'll bring a labeled batch of cookies. :cookie:

Victor: poll time: who'd prefer a PC-heavy night vs mixed console/PC? Reply in-thread with "PC" or "Mixed".

Eli: PC

Sana: Mixed (i love couch play)

Victor: PC

Rowan: Mixed

Eli: Looks like mixed might be the compromise. I'll bring a Switch + dock and my Steam laptop. See y'all Friday for low-lag chaos. :joystick:
